personal.name: Jayson Barateta
personal.title: Python Developer & AI Automation Specialist
personal.bioShort: Delivering scalable network automation (Cisco/Fujitsu), agentic development workflows, and custom AI-powered software for international enterprise clients across Japan and Singapore.
bioParagraphs: With 8+ years of hands-on professional development, I specialize in architecting custom Python platforms that empower network engineers, turning tedious multi-step manual operations into automated, verifiable software systems.

My technical expertise spans concurrent network verification across 100+ Cisco and Fujitsu devices simultaneously, multi-platform low-code orchestration (n8n, Make.com, Power Automate), and structured agentic development workflows that accelerate engineering velocity.

projects.title: AI-Powered Network Configuration Verification
projects.tagline: Automated pre/post configuration diffs and AI-generated analysis across Cisco and Fujitsu enterprise devices.
projects.problem: After configuration changes, network engineers manually inspect each affected area through the CLI and confirm changes device-by-device — a tedious, error-prone process.
projects.solution: Engineered a web-based network automation platform that collects device data, generates exact configuration diffs, and provides AI-generated analysis adding interpretive context across multiple network devices concurrently.
projects.impact: Network engineers significantly increased operational throughput and now handle complex multi-device changes with automated confidence.

projects.title: Agentic Workflow Adoption for Dev Teams
projects.tagline: Standardized agentic engineering practice that turned around a stalled 6-developer team.
projects.problem: A team of 6 developers had spent 3 months with zero shipped features while exhausting 20,000 monthly AI credits mid-development without disciplined architecture.
projects.solution: Simulated the entire project in a single day using structured agentic workflows and disciplined software practices (reaching 70–80% completion), then codified the approach into a team standard and led hands-on training.
projects.impact: The team shipped its first feature within one week of training and accelerated all subsequent delivery cycles.

projects.title: Agentic RAG for Network Device Monitoring
projects.tagline: Autonomous RAG pipeline eliminating manual analysis of 5-minute telemetry chart reports.
projects.problem: An existing tool generated device-activity charts every 5 minutes and compiled them into Excel reports, requiring engineers to manually open and analyze charts to spot anomalies.
projects.solution: Built an agentic RAG workflow using LangChain and Pinecone vector store on top of existing telemetry that analyzes activity in real-time, alerts engineers via Microsoft Teams on high-severity issues, and creates Asana tickets automatically for minor anomalies.
projects.impact: Engineers eliminated manual chart review throughout the day, freeing substantial capacity for building infrastructure.

projects.title: AI Security Compliance & Reporting Workflow
projects.tagline: Automated division-wide security compliance tracking and AI executive report synthesis.
projects.problem: Four team members handled security compliance reminders on top of core duties — tracking 50 division members monthly and manually converting company security emails into division reports.
projects.solution: Created an automated workflow with daily automated Microsoft Teams reminders until actions are completed, plus an AI pipeline that ingests security updates, analyzes policy impact, and regenerates tailored division reports.
projects.impact: Administrative workload dropped from 4 team members to 1, who now simply oversees and distributes the synthesized report.

projects.title: FlowBoard AI Automation Pipeline
projects.tagline: AI-powered n8n system streamlining member onboarding/offboarding with compliance & consistency.
projects.problem: Manual onboarding and cross-system identity provisioning caused operational bottlenecks and audit risks.
projects.solution: Orchestrated end-to-end n8n workflows with webhook triggers, automated credential lifecycle hooks, and validation logging.
projects.impact: Standardized operational onboarding across multiple tools with audit-ready consistency.

projects.title: Motorcycle Shop Management System
projects.tagline: Full-stack operations platform — POS, inventory, payroll calculation, sales tracking & dashboards.
projects.problem: Repair shop operations relied on fragmented paper records, spreadsheets, and manual sales reconciliations.
projects.solution: Developed a comprehensive management system featuring inventory tracking, automated point-of-sale, technician commission payroll, and analytical dashboards.
projects.impact: Provided owners real-time inventory visibility and eliminated end-of-month manual payroll errors.

description: Concurrent network automation: Engineered concurrent Python scripts and Ansible playbooks automating end-to-end device verification across 100+ Cisco devices simultaneously, reducing post-configuration manual workload by 90%.

User-centric tool design: Replaced a tedious manual verification process (jump servers, manual commands, file diffing) with an intuitive two-step tool workflow that automates data collection and instantly highlights configuration changes.
Desktop & CLI development: Architected robust CLI and desktop automation applications using the MVC design pattern, optimizing operational tools used by network engineers.

Workflow orchestration & APIs: Designed and deployed end-to-end integration workflows using n8n, Make.com, Zapier, and Microsoft Power Automate, leveraging webhooks and native platform APIs to bridge disjointed enterprise systems.
Global collaboration: Partnered directly with Japanese clients to translate complex business requirements into production-ready software under Agile Scrum and Waterfall frameworks.
Code quality: Enforced PEP 8 standards, regular self and team code reviews, and comprehensive end-to-end testing.
Developed and maintained mission-critical Python automation scripts validating complex architectural data structures.
Contributed to R&D on geometric calculation algorithms and compliance checks for 3D building models.
Optimized complex SQL queries embedded in Python scripts processing 500k+ rows of architectural data, cutting rule execution runtime by 50%.
Investigated, replicated, and resolved high-priority bugs across legacy and modern codebases while championing readability and maintainability.
Built Python and Lua scripts translating technical regulatory building codes into automated validation rules and executable logic.
Collaborated with professional Building Architects and Singapore Government SMEs to gather precise criteria for software-driven compliance checks.
Built foundational expertise in clean coding, debugging, and the SDLC within a highly regulated enterprise domain.
